name: Former Villagers Keep Aging Among the Heathens
description: A villager who leaves your tribe and becomes a Heathen -- by losing Faith (The Breaking Point), an island event such as The Spa or The Cracked Mask, a Custom Island Event, any way at all -- keeps growing older among the Heathens, as believers do: their age goes up, their hair greys at the usual age, and they can die of old age by exactly the believers' rule (each year past 55, or later with Medicine). They still never eat, starve or fall sick: only aging and old age apply. Heathens who were never your villagers (the camp's own, the puzzle Heathens) do not age. When one dies, a new Heathen joins the camp at once in their place, so the camp keeps its number. **What is left when they die is decided by "All Heathens Leave Skeletons" or "Former Villagers Among the Heathens Leave Skeletons"**; with neither they simply disappear from the camp, no grave. Every death goes in the Deaths log (cause: old age) and each newcomer in the Births log's Arrived records. **Heathens never count in the Village Statistics.** **Villagers who left before this patch are recognised by the parents on their record** (born in your village); one who never had parents there (a founder or newcomer) is recognised only if they leave after the patch is installed. **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP Heathen Aging.dll"; it keeps its own small file per save, never writes a save.
behavior_changes: The age credit 0x46FE90 adds a living aging Heathen's units to its age +0x1B8C, as 0x46F7F0 does for a believer (0x470077); every other Heathen as the stock game (no age).

The life tick 0x472C90 gives an aging Heathen one unit for each unit of its age not yet processed (+0x1C3C), live and in the load-time catch-up, a Time Warp and a time skip (all of them come through the age credit and the life tick): at each whole year of the processed age past 1,100 + 160 x (Medicine - 1) units (the tech level read at 0x51D5D0, as 0x423600(1) reads it), rand(100) < 10 x the years over takes them -- the believers' old-age rule (0x472FC6..0x47304A). Nothing else of a believer's unit runs: no eating, starving, sickness, health, Faith drift, job or offline job ticks.

A death: with a skeleton row covering them, SetHealth 0x4758B0(0, 2 Old age) makes the body the believers' "Burying the dead" (0x46F130, 0x473F50) buries into the Roster of the Dead 0x464C70, as a believer's; the Village Statistics' death counter 0x51D3A0 is put back; a puzzle Heathen's body gets role 0 so the role finder 0x470690 finds the new one. Otherwise the activity stops (0x473440), the selection is dropped when it is theirs (0x4653D0, 0x470800), the presence byte +0x1CD4 is cleared, health untouched, and the Cause of Death companion writes the Death record (VvfpCauseDiedAmongHeathens: Old age, "no grave (died among the Heathens: nothing was left)").

The replacement, in the same tick, by the Heathen creator 0x46FD20 (Faith 1 there, so its SetFaith never runs to-a-Heathen; the camp's -38 - rand(30) written to +0x1CF0 after): an ordinary Heathen in the dead one's camp role (0..11) and mask (+0x1CED orange, +0x1CEE red), age 400, random sex; a former villager's replacement an ordinary blue, orange or red Heathen (13 : 7 : 3, the camp's mix), role 0; a puzzle Heathen (roles 12-17) whose puzzle (1, 16, 13, 9, 5, 17: progress 0x51E008 + 8p against 0x51DF30 + 4p) is unsolved by the stock camp's own set-up of that role (0x424AC0; the Heathen Mommy's as the restored puzzle makes her, with her infant 0x465E00 forced, its father an adult Heathen man when there is one). A full table: owed until a record is free. The Cause of Death companion writes its Arrived record (VvfpCauseHeathenArrived).

Who turned Heathen: a living believer the age credit has seen, at to-a-Heathen 0x4669E0 and The Spa's and The Cracked Mask's faction calls (0x415D0C, 0x416C5B), by identity (name, likes, dislikes), kept per save slot in "Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Heathen Aging\Heathen Aging - Save <S>.dat"; one who turned before the row by the parents on the record (+0x1BC0 / +0x1BD9).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion splices five sites at run time, only after verifying their stock bytes, all or none; each splice makes the very instructions it replaced.
A Heathen still never eats, starves, falls sick, loses health, drifts in Faith, works or uses the work system.
Heathens never count in the Village Statistics: the death counter is put back, the Oldest Villager maximum skips them where the statistics rows say so, a Heathen mother's babies are not counted.
Nothing is written to a save. Without the Cause of Death companion, nothing is logged.
